exercises.question: Which sentence narrates a close call and a vow after a mishap accurately?
options: Estuve a punto de cancelar la cena, pero nos salvamos por los pelos; no vuelvo a improvisar así.
Estuve a punto cancelar la cena, pero nos salvamos por los pelos; no vuelvo a improvisar así.
Estuve a punto de cancelar la cena, pero nos salvamos por los pelos; no vuelvo improvisar así.
Estuve a punto en cancelar la cena, pero nos salvamos por los pelos; no vuelvo a improvisar así.

exercises.sentence: Cuando todo parecía salir mal, _____ a punto de rendirme, pero Carlos nos sacó de un apuro al instante.
exercises.english: When everything seemed to be going wrong, I was on the verge of giving up, but Carlos got us out of a jam right away.

exercises.sentence: Después de aquel susto, prometió que no _____ a cocinar sin revisar el horno.
exercises.english: After that scare, she promised that she would not cook again without checking the oven.

exercises.sentence: Estuvimos a punto de perder el último tren, pero logramos subir por los pelos.
options: We were on the verge of missing the last train, but we barely managed to get on.
We were on the verge of missing the first train, but we barely managed to get on.
We were on the verge of missing the last train, and we could not manage to get on.

exercises.question: Which expression means that an event or plan turned out brilliantly?
options: salir redondo
salir mal
por los pelos
al instante

exercises.question: What two mishaps happened in the kitchen before Carlos arrived?
options: The broth spilled onto the tablecloth and the sponge cake burned in the oven.
Meg forgot to buy the spices and her friend dropped the finished stew on the floor.
The oven stopped working and the guests arrived an hour earlier than planned.

exercises.question: How did Carlos help Meg and her friend save the evening?
options: He ordered dinner from a restaurant near his office so they would not have to cook.
He brought fresh bread and fruit, helped season the stew, and set out quick snacks.
He followed the original cake recipe to the letter and baked a second cake quickly.

exercises.question: What does Meg vow at the end of the story?
options: That she will never invite her classmates over to her apartment in Budapest again.
That she will stop cooking stews and only prepare cold snacks from now on.
That she will never try a new recipe for a party without testing it first.

Sí, salió redonda, aunque estuve a punto de cancelar todo y no vuelvo improvisar a última hora.

exercises.question: Which sentence uses *volver a* + infinitive accurately for repetition rather than returning to a place?
options: Volvimos a probar el guiso y el plato salió redondo.
Volvimos a la cocina y el plato salió redondo.
Volvimos probar el guiso y el plato salió redondo.
Volvimos de probar el guiso y el plato salió redondo.
